description: Owner-only live SQLite page/freelist and database/WAL/SHM file observations. Reports whether this managed connection uses the control-admitted VFS; whole-workspace physical enforcement and repair remain unavailable. File sizes and connection-local settings are non-atomic observations, not reserved space.
name: opencut_database_inspect

database_file_bytes.description: None means unavailable; for a persistent database an absent sidecar is "0".

managed_vfs_enabled.description: This particular managed connection uses OpenCut's control-admitted VFS.

description: Owner-only explicit passive or truncate WAL checkpoint. Reports complete, blocked or not_applicable; timeout bounds lock waiting, not filesystem IO. Does not delete history, vacuum, terminate readers or guarantee free space. Repeat only explicitly; results are live observations, not durable idempotency receipts.
name: opencut_database_checkpoint

observed_wal_file_bytes.description: File size is observed after the operation; concurrent writers may change it.

description: Owner-only read-only admission policy, payload observation and durable reservations. Optional control section reports a separate database limit and observed files, but write interception is not yet enabled. No files created or recovery performed; volume space is observational and all workspace writers are not covered.
name: opencut_storage_budget_inspect

admission_headroom_bytes.description: Absent until the workspace database file name has been bound.

write_interception_enabled.description: True only once all managed SQLite writes use the guarded VFS.

description: Owner-only persist payload and optional independent database-control limits with expected revision and stable idempotency key. Omitted control limit preserves it. Lower limits affect new reservations and growth; already admitted writes may finish. Does not delete data or change upload source quotas.

control_limit_bytes.description: Omission preserves the current database-control ceiling.

media_output_limit_bytes.description: Omission preserves the current ceiling, including for older consumers.

name: opencut_storage_budget_configure

description: Owner-only reconcile crashed payload and control reservations using OS lifetime locks, then observe current managed bytes. Never expires a live writer by clock or deletes files. SQLite write interception and whole-workspace enforcement are not yet enabled.
name: opencut_storage_budget_recover

admission_headroom_bytes.description: Absent until the workspace database file name has been bound.

write_interception_enabled.description: True only once all managed SQLite writes use the guarded VFS.

description: Owner-only bounded discovery of durable CAS collection plans. Defaults to unfinished plans. Limit bounds examined rows, so an empty filtered page may still have next_cursor. Forward cursor is bound to the filter and a stored plan in this workspace; plan states are observed live. Query never executes collection.
name: opencut_cas_gc_query

description: Owner-only: persist a reviewed collection plan for unreferenced canonical CAS objects and abandoned capture temporaries. Protects all retained revisions, accepted jobs and project media. No file deletion. Idempotent key; cursor enumerates live namespace. Does not reclaim artifacts or impose quotas.
name: opencut_cas_gc_plan

description: Owner-only: inspect a durable CAS collection plan and per-object outcomes. Removing means unresolved; explicitly retry execute. Does not change the plan or files.
name: opencut_cas_gc_inspect

description: Owner-only: explicitly execute the exact reviewed plan hash. Rechecks all references under the CAS publication gate. Newly referenced or changed objects are retained. Durable receipts support crash recovery; retry the same plan, never infer reclaimed disk bytes from logical sizes.
name: opencut_cas_gc_execute

description: Owner-only: inspect whether a successful job artifact still has its default retention root. Released does not mean deleted or unavailable; actual bytes are checked at download. Does not expose native paths.
name: opencut_artifact_retention_inspect

description: Owner-only bounded scan of persisted project revisions, task inputs and other task results, project media and plugin configuration for references to one published artifact. Reports root identities and native source candidate count without paths. Observational only: native aliases and concurrent publication are not yet resolved, so an empty result is not deletion eligibility.
name: opencut_artifact_references_inspect

description: Owner-only: durably release one successful job artifact's default retention root under an exact idempotency key. Does not delete bytes, alter job success or override other retained references. Inspect before retrying with a different key.
name: opencut_artifact_retention_release

description: Owner-only bounded native storage observation. Reports managed categories, unique inode bytes, partial scans and volume availability without exposing paths. Live scan, not an atomic snapshot, quota reservation or garbage-collection plan. Never deletes or repairs files.
name: opencut_storage_inspect

allocated_bytes.description: st_blocks * 512 for unique regular files and directories, not exclusive space.

logical_bytes.description: Unique regular-file lengths. Decimal strings avoid client integer truncation.

present.description: False also when the budget was exhausted before inspecting this category.

description: Create an idempotent project upload session. Requires read+edit+run_jobs. Send raw chunks through the authenticated HTTP data endpoint advertised by capabilities; never include media bytes or host paths in tool JSON.
name: opencut_upload_create

description: Read upload state and confirmed next_offset before resuming a transfer. Requires project read; does not create or repair files.
name: opencut_upload_inspect

description: Abort a receiving upload. Requires read+edit+run_jobs. Sealed uploads have accepted jobs; cancel those jobs explicitly instead.
name: opencut_upload_abort

description: Read this upload's retained staging reservation and current release eligibility. Requires project read. Eligibility is observational; release rechecks terminal state and permissions.
name: opencut_upload_retention

release_eligible.description: Observation only. Release rechecks authorization and terminal state.

description: Release private chunks only for an aborted upload or terminal import job. Requires read+edit+run_jobs; queued/running jobs reject. Does not delete the imported CAS resource or project history. Retry pending cleanup; quota is freed only after durable deletion.
name: opencut_upload_release

release_eligible.description: Observation only. Release rechecks authorization and terminal state.

description: Read this project's logical upload staging reservations and configured limits. Requires project read; never reveals another project's usage. Does not measure CAS, artifact or filesystem disk usage.
name: opencut_upload_quota

workspace_limit_bytes.description: Configured limit, not another project's usage.

description: Discover project uploads and their retention/cleanup eligibility with bounded cursor pagination. Defaults to retained reservations; set retained_only=false for history. Cursor fixes creation upper bound and filter; status remains live. Requires project read; query does not clean files.
name: opencut_upload_query

release_eligible.description: Observation only. Release rechecks authorization and terminal state.

description: Atomically seal a complete upload and accept one durable media.import job. Retrying returns the same job_id. Does not edit the project. Read the job extended_result, then bind its project media asset explicitly.
name: opencut_upload_seal

description: Read a verified imported resource belonging to this project. Opaque references do not grant access to another project's media or global CAS hashes.
name: opencut_project_media_inspect

MediaImportJobResult.description: A project resource, not a global CAS capability or a host filesystem location.

description: Read a bounded page of this project's imported media. Cursor fixes first-page membership, is bound to stored project anchors, and is not a capability.
name: opencut_project_media_query

MediaImportJobResult.description: A project resource, not a global CAS capability or a host filesystem location.

description: Inspect the authenticated principal and its current project grants. Does not reveal credentials or other principals.
name: opencut_access_inspect

description: Owner-only plugin package and permission publication provenance since schema 7. Independent from media publication history. Prepared is not success; observed phases record locked reconciliation without asserting historical causality.
name: opencut_plugin_publication_query

description: Owner-only: lock a plugin version, observe the package or grants digest, and resolve pending publication records. Does not rewrite files or grant permissions.
name: opencut_plugin_publication_reconcile

description: Owner-only append-only native publication provenance since schema 6. Prepared is not success. Completed confirms normal publication; observed_* records locked reconciliation without claiming historical causality. Separate decimal sequence space.
name: opencut_maintenance_query

description: Owner-only: lock a media object, observe its actual digest and append resolutions for pending publication records. Does not rewrite media bytes or metadata. Waits for cooperating writers; never classifies their live publication while unlocked.
name: opencut_maintenance_reconcile

description: Owner-only administration history since schema 5: committed policies and credential lifecycle, without secrets or digests. Paginate with decimal last_sequence; pages are also bounded by a 4 MB record budget. Separate sequence space from project/job audit.
name: opencut_access_audit_query

AccessAuditRecord.description: Administration history, never a credential or an authorization decision.

policy.description: Policy as committed at this event; later changes do not rewrite it.

description: Read a published OpenCut resource URI through the shared application authority. Includes immutable revision context, current summaries, safe task views, artifact descriptions and schemas. Does not execute edits or return arbitrary files.
name: opencut_resource_read

scoped_preflight.description: Scoped preflight requires run_jobs and immutable project content.

line_height.description: Line height in canvas pixels. None derives it from font_size.

max_width.description: Maximum layout width in canvas pixels. None uses the backend's canvas margin.

HostCapabilities.description: Extended host discovery. The v1 tool retains its frozen, extension-tolerant DTO.

extended_result.description: New task kinds use the open registry envelope; legacy result variants stay frozen.

description: Read committed project or public task events with per-event cursors bound to stream, filter and stored event identity. Observing never cancels a task. Resume with the last fully processed cursor.
name: opencut_event_changes

description: Read the public task view with typed results and content-bound artifact references. Excludes execution input, native paths, leases and raw diagnostics. Artifact availability is checked at download, not inferred from historical task success.
name: opencut_job_view

extended_result.description: New task kinds use the open registry envelope; legacy result variants stay frozen.

description: Read a bounded page of public task views. Cursor fixes membership at the first page; states remain current observations. Do not reuse a cursor from another workspace.
name: opencut_job_query

extended_result.description: New task kinds use the open registry envelope; legacy result variants stay frozen.

description: Read durable public task changes using an opaque cursor bound to the event stream and job filter. No worker payload or lease details are exposed.
name: opencut_job_changes

description: Accept a durable task and return its public view. Same idempotency scope as legacy job_start. Native source-only v1 input locations are still host-local; project inputs bind an immutable revision.
name: opencut_job_submit

extended_result.description: New task kinds use the open registry envelope; legacy result variants stay frozen.

description: Explicitly request durable task cancellation and return the public view. Stopping a client wait is a separate action. Terminal results remain terminal.
name: opencut_job_request_cancel

extended_result.description: New task kinds use the open registry envelope; legacy result variants stay frozen.

description: Inspect uploaded media metadata and its compare-and-repair token. Does not probe or change project revisions.
name: opencut_media_inspect

metadata_hash.description: Compare-and-repair token over exact stored JSON, including malformed JSON.

description: Repair uploaded media metadata from verified content bytes. Requires the metadata_hash observed by media_inspect (null for missing metadata). Does not modify historical projects or media bytes.
name: opencut_media_repair

metadata_hash.description: Compare-and-repair token over exact stored JSON, including malformed JSON.

description: Read immutable revision ancestry newest first. Pass next_cursor as from_revision to continue without page shifts after new edits.
name: opencut_project_history

description: Read a specific immutable project revision.
name: opencut_revision_inspect

line_height.description: Line height in canvas pixels. None derives it from font_size.

max_width.description: Maximum layout width in canvas pixels. None uses the backend's canvas margin.

description: Create a new revision with the contents of a prior revision. Restores the entire project, preserves history and render snapshots, requires expected_revision and an idempotency key.
name: opencut_revision_restore

description: Read committed mutation provenance since database schema 4. Does not reconstruct unknown historical actors; sequence positions are decimal strings.
name: opencut_audit_query

description: Read implemented capabilities and runtime limits.
name: opencut_capabilities

description: List persisted projects and their current revisions.
name: opencut_project_list

name: opencut_project_create

name: opencut_project_inspect

description: Read committed events after a sequence number (maximum 500).
name: opencut_events_read

description: Read durable job lifecycle and progress events after a sequence number, optionally filtered by job ID (maximum 500).
name: opencut_job_events

description: Accept a durable media or fixed-revision render job. Outputs are stored in the workspace, not arbitrary requested paths. A worker must be running.
name: opencut_job_start

description: Check whether a fixed project revision and sequence can be rendered, returning structured issues without creating a job or output.
name: opencut_render_preflight

description: Read durable task state, result and failure details. A failed job is a successful query result.
name: opencut_job_get

description: List persisted jobs and their current state.

description: Owner-only bounded authorization denial audit, including anonymous authentication failures. Filter by server request, verified principal or credential. At most 10000 records retained, 200 per page; stale cursors expire. Never includes tokens, request bodies or original URLs.
name: opencut_denial_query

description: Owner-only compare-and-set project plugin policy, pinned to package SHA and named contributions. Revision 0 creates. Idempotent receipt; does not change project head or install packages.
name: opencut_project_plugin_grant

description: Read this project's plugin policies (maximum 64, including disabled). Grants are not installation availability; inspect a named contribution for its current contract.
name: opencut_project_plugin_list

description: Discover a granted project's contribution with inline JSON schemas and effective host limits, without native paths. Requires project read, enabled exact-package policy and global plugin permissions.
name: opencut_project_plugin_inspect

description: Propose validated operations against a fixed revision using the granted exact package. Requires read, edit and run_jobs. Rechecks policy before execution and return. Does not commit; explicitly apply with the same expected revision and a new idempotency key.
name: opencut_project_plugin_plan

max_width.description: Maximum layout width in canvas pixels. None uses the backend's canvas margin.

name: opencut_plugin_plan
